upstream.description: WiFi-3D-Fusion is an open-source research project that leverages WiFi CSI signals and deep learning to estimate 3D human pose, fusing wireless sensing with computer vision techniques for next-generation spatial awareness.

classification.analysis: WiFi-3D-Fusion is a Python research pipeline that turns WiFi CSI/RSSI signals, captured from an ESP32 or a Nexmon-patched adapter, into real-time 3D human pose and motion sensing, fusing device-free wireless sensing with a CNN detector and a Three.js/Open3D live viewer. It bridges to academic projects like Person-in-WiFi-3D and NeRF-squared, and supports training and continuous learning of its own detection models on captured CSI data. Aimed at researchers and hobbyists experimenting with through-wall, device-free human sensing; explicitly labeled research-only, and the repository has had no commits since August 2025.

use_cases.title: Detect and visualize human motion through walls using WiFi signals
Estimate 3D human pose from CSI data with a trained CNN
Build a low-cost ESP32-based WiFi sensing rig
